notes: Critical dispatch-stdin fix. Phase 0 (b3a5ab06) shipped runProvider with spawnSync({encoding:'buffer', input: <string>}) — Node requires Buffer-typed input when encoding is 'buffer'; the call threw ERR_UNKNOWN_ENCODING synchronously before any CLI ran. Every diff-model review (gauntlet, sprint planning, redteam, qa, compliance) silently failed. 0.4.4 wraps the input in Buffer.from(promptContent,'utf8'). Re-bootstrap to fix.
